answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 45871 Country: AF Title: Salah Question: I am Hanafi, is it allowable for me to pray after Wahabi, (Ghair Muqallid) even they are calling to us by the name Mushrik. Answer ID: 45871 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 936/737/B=1434) One should not offer salah behind such staunch ghair muqallid who counts all the Muqallids as mushrik, and abuses Hadhrat Imam Abu Hanifa (رحمة الله) as well as has false beliefs. Such person is fasiq (transgressor) without any doubt and one is forbidden in the Hadith to offer salah behind a fasiq person. ولا يؤم فاجر مؤمناً (ابن ماجہ). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
